# disrobe-capabilities ELF procedure-linkage-table reference
#
# Each data line is one procedure-linkage-table stub of the fixture named by the
# preceding bracketed path: the stub virtual address, then the imported symbol the
# stub jumps to. Paths are relative to the repository root.
#
# Reference tool: llvm-objdump (LLVM version 19.1.7), independent of disrobe.
# Command: llvm-objdump -d --section=.plt <fixture>
# The <symbol@plt> labels llvm-objdump prints come from the .rela.plt relocations
# joined to .dynsym, not from any disrobe code path.
#
# The test that reads this file fails when the file or a fixture is missing.
